summary: Batch-1 iPhone responsive audit (375x667 SE, 390x844 13/14, 393x852 15/16 & Pro, 430x932 15 Pro Max). Verified full interactive journey per viewport: MainMenu scroll fix, gameplay entry & flap, crash/game-over layout, revive-then-crash collapse, drunkness slider drag, PIGEONS store scroll, LEADERBOARD nickname entry, Easy Mode purchase modal + sim success. The reported MainMenu overflow on 375x667 is FIXED — PLAY / PIGEONS / LEADERBOARD are reachable and tappable via scroll on all iPhone sizes. Game-over card fully fits on 375x667 (last button MAIN MENU bottom = 653/667). Revive collapse is clean (no blank gap) after one use. Drunkness thumb drag works (x moved 187.5 → 282). Nickname input + SAVE NAME button both visible on 375x667 and long nicknames accepted; save flow returns ✓ status. However several issues found — see below.

ui_bugs.issue: After purchase (sim-success), Easy Mode card's selected border is rgba(126,200,242,0.35) (light blue) while standard manors (map-day/dusk/night/random) use rgb(255,210,63) (yellow) when selected. Spec explicitly requires SAME yellow selected border. Confirmed: clicking map-dusk yields yellow rgb(255,210,63); map-easy stays light-blue.

restart-button y=6 (h=40), distance-hud y=11, chip-hud y=9, exit-button y=11.5 all sit within top ~50px zone across every iPhone viewport tested. On Expo Web, SafeAreaView returns 0 insets so this cannot be visually verified against a Dynamic Island / notch. On native iOS 15 Pro/Pro Max the top inset should push HUD down; needs on-device verification or an explicit web fallback (paddingTop: Platform.OS==='web' ? 44 : 0) to avoid Dynamic Island overlap.

On 390x844, 393x852 and 430x932 the button bottoms sit within the bottom 34px home-indicator reserve zone in web preview (PLAY y+h=836/844; LEADERBOARD y+h=916/932). Same SafeAreaView-on-web cause; should be OK on native iOS but verify bottom safe-area inset is applied or add explicit paddingBottom fallback for web.

sound-toggle 96x27, open-code-button 68x27, drunkness-thumb 22x22 (though parent slider hitbox is 117 tall so acceptable), easy-price 35x15 (parent card is 96x101 so acceptable), restore-purchases 183x35, pigeons-back 82x45 (OK), leaderboard-back 82x45 (OK). Consider raising sound-toggle/open-code-button/restore-purchases to 44px min height for iOS HIG.

integration_issues.flow: Testid drift vs spec (not functionality — but breaks spec-based testing)
integration_issues.issue: Spec referenced testids do not match actual DOM: play-again -> play-again-button; submit-nickname -> nickname-save; silly-mode -> show-silly; hud-restart/hud-menu/hud-distance/hud-chips -> restart-button/exit-button/distance-hud/chip-hud; buy-bundle -> unlock-all-button. Also gameover ids are go-distance/go-best-distance/go-score/go-best/go-chips (not gameover-*). Recommend aligning either the code or the spec.

issues: No horizontal clipping observed; all 7 pigeons (Classic/Business/Roadman/King/Gym/Tourist/Fancy) present via scroll. Restore purchases button is only 35px tall — small tap target.
Nickname input (271x46) and SAVE NAME (311x41) both fit without keyboard overlap. Long nicknames (SuperLongNicknameTest...) accepted; rows render 3,000m distances without clipping.

action_items: Fix Easy Mode selected border to match standard manors: use the same yellow (rgb(255,210,63)) selection style used by other map cards when Easy Mode is the chosenMap.

Add web fallback padding for SafeAreaView (top for GameScreen HUD, bottom for MainMenu) so Expo Web preview correctly reserves ~44px top for Dynamic Island and ~34px bottom for home-indicator, or verify on real iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max device that native safe-area insets already handle it.

Align testids with the audit spec (or update the spec): play-again-button, nickname-save, show-silly, restart-button, exit-button, distance-hud, chip-hud, go-* prefix for game over, unlock-all-button.
Bump sound-toggle / open-code-button / restore-purchases height to 44px for iOS HIG compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: Easy Mode card has divergent selectedBorder color logic — likely a distinct style branch for map-easy that hard-codes the blue accent instead of reusing the shared selected-border token.

GameScreen HUD relies solely on SafeAreaView edges={top:true}; Expo Web returns 0 inset so any real-device Dynamic Island overlap is invisible in this audit. Add Constants.statusBarHeight or Platform.OS==='web' fallback.

MainMenu ScrollView fix works correctly on 375x667 (confirmed play/pigeons/leaderboard reachable). Same ScrollView on larger viewports leaves the bottom row very close to the home-indicator zone in web preview only.

success_rate.frontend: iPhone SE 375x667: PASS on 11/12 criteria (fail: Easy Mode border color); iPhone 13/14, 15/16, 15 Pro Max: PASS on 10/12 (Easy Mode border + bottom safe-area proximity in web preview); Dynamic Island top-safe verification requires on-device native run.

seed_data_creation: None. Anonymous UUID player generated by app; no persistent test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 1 (iPhone) done. Batch 2 = Samsung viewports (360x640 S8, 360x800 S20/S21, 384x854 S24, 412x915 A54, etc). Reuse this playwright pattern: set_viewport_size then goto BASE. The MainMenu is wrapped in ScrollView so use scroll_into_view_if_needed on each testid before bbox checks. Real testids in the app: play-button, pigeons-button, leaderboard-button, drunkness-slider, drunkness-thumb, sound-toggle, open-code-button, map-day/dusk/night/random/easy, easy-price, easy-purchase-sheet, easy-sim-success, easy-sim-fail, easy-sim-cancel, easy-buy-cancel, flap-area, restart-button, exit-button, distance-hud, chip-hud, score-hud, game-over-overlay, death-message, new-best-badge, go-distance/go-best-distance/go-score/go-best/go-chips, play-again-button, revive-button, menu-button, pigeons-back, pigeon-card-<id>, grid-pigeon-<id>, price-<id>, preview-pigeon-<id>, unlock-all-button, remove-ads-button, restore-purchases, leaderboard-back, leaderboard-title, nickname-input, nickname-save, nickname-status, nickname-warning, show-silly, lb-row-N. Known open issue to re-verify after fix: Easy Mode selected border color must match yellow rgb(255,210,63).
rca of the issue: Easy Mode border mismatch: the MainMenu likely defines a dedicated style for the Easy Mode card (blue accent theme) rather than composing the shared 'selected' border with the base card style. When chosenMap==='easy', the selected border should be the same yellow token used by map-day/dusk/night/random. Fix location: /app/frontend/src/screens/MainMenu.js — the map-easy card style block should apply the same borderColor when it is the chosenMap as the other manor cards (or use a single conditional selectedBorderColor='#FFD23F' regardless of card type).
